note: coverId values point to images stored inside the Claude artifact and will not resolve outside it. Treat them as placeholders and re-attach photos in the new app.

records.title: Both Directions at Once: The Lost Album
records.label: Impulse!
records.format: Deluxe edition, 2LP — includes every take from the session
records.valueNote: The deluxe 2LP is still in print at roughly $38-45 new, so opened copies in this shape sit around $28-35. Opening it costs almost nothing on a title you can still buy.
records.notes: Recorded March 1963 with the classic quartet, unreleased until 2018. Sticker price $26.

records.title: Ascension
records.label: Impulse!
records.valueNote: Single-LP reissues run about $25-34 new. A 1966 Impulse! original in clean shape is a different animal, more like $80-200. The 2026 Verve Vault 2LP with both editions is about $38.
records.notes: The big free-jazz blowout — eleven players at once. Two complete takes exist, Edition I and Edition II; standard reissues carry Edition II. Look in the deadwax for an etched marking.

records.title: Ballads
records.label: Impulse!
records.valueNote: Everything depends on the label footer. 'A PRODUCT OF AM-PAR RECORD CORP' = original first pressing. 'ABC-PARAMOUNT' = 1963-66 repress. 'ABC RECORDS INC' = 1967-68. A '-A'/'-B' suffix after the catalog number means 1965 or later.
records.notes: With McCoy Tyner, Jimmy Garrison and Elvin Jones. Recorded at Van Gelder, December 1961 and autumn 1962. The quartet had never played these tunes — they turned up with sheet music from a music store, half-rehearsed for thirty minutes and cut nearly every track in a single take.

records.title: Today and Tomorrow
records.label: Impulse!
records.valueNote: Less common than the Coltrane titles. Same label-footer rule applies. A current Verve By Request reissue sells new around $38, which caps what a mid-grade used copy should cost.
records.notes: Tyner's third Impulse! album, from two sessions in 1963 and 1964. Side A is a sextet with Thad Jones, Frank Strozier, John Gilmore and Elvin Jones. Side B is his trio with Jimmy Garrison and Tootie Heath — and 'When Sunny Gets Blue' closes it.

records.title: The Real McCoy
records.label: Blue Note
records.format: Stereo, Blue Note Classic Vinyl Series (2020), 180g
records.valueNote: Settled: the 2020 Classic Vinyl Series pressing, mastered by Kevin Gray, pressed in Germany. Sells new around $28-35, so a clean used copy sits at $20-32. No upgrade needed.
records.notes: Recorded in a single day, 21 April 1967, at Van Gelder Studio. Produced by Alfred Lion. Joe Henderson, Ron Carter, Elvin Jones. Tyner's first Blue Note as leader. Opens with 'Passion Dance'.

records.title: At the Top: Poinciana Revisited
records.label: Impulse!
records.valueNote: Dealers ask around $24 for a VG+ original; clean copies turn up often. $15 is a good show price.
records.notes: Live at the Village Gate, 1968. The cover shows the impulse!/ABC logo, pointing to an original-era pressing rather than the later MCA reissue. Plentiful on Discogs.

records.title: At the Pershing: But Not for Me
records.label: Argo
records.valueNote: Discogs median sale about $30, clean copies to $70, rough ones under $5. Very common. Check the label: black = first pressing, grey = second, dark blue = the 1958 stereo.
records.notes: Recorded live at the Pershing Lounge, Chicago, 16 January 1958, with Israel Crosby and Vernel Fournier. The original 'Poinciana'. One of the best-selling jazz albums ever made.

records.title: Legend: The Best of Bob Marley and the Wailers
records.label: Island / Tuff Gong
records.valueNote: Rough range, not checked against sales. One of the most common records on earth — never pay a premium unless it is an early Island pressing.
records.notes: The best-selling reggae album ever made, first released 1984. Endlessly repressed, so the pressing matters more than usual.

records.title: Trojan Records: Jamaican R&B / Blues, Volume 1
records.label: Trojan
records.valueNote: Rough range, not checked against sales. Trojan compilations are pressed in quantity and stay affordable.
records.notes: Trojan's Jamaican R&B and blues compilation, volume one — the pre-ska sound that reggae grew out of.

records.title: Christmas with McGuffey Lane
records.valueNote: Rough range, not checked against sales. Regional promo Christmas LPs are cheap almost everywhere except the region that remembers them.
records.notes: Ohio country-rock band. A regional promo LP presented by Rax Roast Beef, benefiting asthma research. Pink $5 store sticker on the front.

records.title: The Grinch — Original Motion Picture Soundtrack
records.valueNote: Rough range, not checked against sales. Modern soundtrack pressings hold near retail; coloured-vinyl variants run higher.
records.notes: Original motion picture soundtrack to Illumination's The Grinch, 2018. Score by Danny Elfman, with Tyler, the Creator's version of 'You're a Mean One, Mr. Grinch'.
